steps_lead: Paste a public product page, confirm the captured reference and download a short video for ads or social posts.

maker.cta: Make a video from this link

faq.q: What does the product URL provide?
faq.a: A readable public page supplies its main product image and name as the starting reference.

faq.q: Can I use a public Shopify or Amazon product page?
faq.a: Yes. Use a public Shopify or Amazon product page that loads without sign-in and shows the variant you sell.

faq.q: What if the page requires a login?
faq.a: Upload the product photo directly when the page requires a login, blocks access or has no usable image.

faq.q: Can I use the same link for another version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the same public URL again and choose a new scene, opening or length for another version.

faq.q: Does the URL include prices or reviews?
faq.a: No. The tool uses the product image and name; add current prices or reviews in your editor.

faq.q: How long can the video be?
Can I use the video in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the download in TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or other ad channels.
